positions.title: Entrepreneur in Residence
positions.description: Joined as the 2nd business hire and helped raise seed funding. Gained experience in creating systems and processes for scalability, including customer success, product management, and sales strategy. Just before the LLM hype, we were building an AI-powered digital assistant for deskless workers, aiming to make organizational knowledge more accessible and combat the skills shortage. I believed in the product, but would have done many things differently. Left to fully commit to CDTM and other projects.

We enable a wide range of businesses from grocery & prepared meals to laundry and retail to efficiently deliver goods & services to customers, and decrease logistics costs by improving route planning and providing detailed analytics and business insights.

positions.title: Analytics & Insights Specialist - DACH Selling & Market Operations
positions.description: Hired by P&G with the initial plan to fully commit. Curious about corporate life, I wanted to deepen my hard skills, work with large data sets and budgets, and earn well to extend my personal runway. Enjoyed the B2B and B2C blend, but found the pace and flexibility lacking. Started learning company politics. Tbh, my focus was split as I was also building Reinio on the side.

positions.title: Co-Founder

positions.title: Business Intelligence Analyst, Data Engineer

company.name: osapiens
company.description:
osapiens – one platform for sustainable growth 

osapiens develops software that empowers companies to drive sustainable growth across their entire value chain.  

The osapiens HUB, a multi-tenant hyperscaler platform designed to enable cross-company collaboration and AI-automation, combines over 25 solutions in two categories: Transparency solutions enable companies to report on financial and non-financial data, manage supply chains, mitigate risk of all kinds (including cyber-risks and trade- and geo-political risks), and ensure compliance with product, reporting and supply chain regulations. Efficiency solutions enable AI-driven supplier collaboration, maintenance, service, and distribution processes to improve operational performance and strengthen competitiveness.  

osapiens was founded in 2018. Headquartered in Mannheim, Germany, with offices across Europe and the United States, the company works with an international team of over 550 employees. It supports more than 2,500 customers worldwide, from SMEs to global enterprises across industries.
